title: October Side Dish Special!
subtitle: Sugar Snap Salad with Radish, Feta and Mint
description: Serve up springtime flavours with this fast and fresh salad. Blanch seasonal greens, toss them with radish and herbs, scatter with almonds and feta, then drizzle with a vibrant minty dressing.

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Bring a medium saucepan of water to the boil for the greens. Halve the broccolini lengthwise. Trim the stems from the sugar snap peas, removing the strings from one side. Thinly slice the radish with a sharp knife or mandoline. Pick the mint leaves, discarding the stems.

Blanch greens: Cook the sugar snap peas in the pan of boiling water for 2 mins or until tender but still with crunch. Remove with a slotted spoon and rinse under cold water. Add the broccolini to the pan of boiling water and cook for 3 mins or until tender. Drain and rinse under cold water.
Toast almonds: Meanwhile, put the almonds in a cold small frypan over medium heat. Toast, tossing, for 3-4 mins until evenly golden. Remove from the pan.

Make dressing: Combine half the mint leaves, 2 tbs olive oil, 1 tbs white wine vinegar, 1 tsp dijon mustard and 2 tsp honey in a jug. Blend with a stick blender until smooth and well combined (see Kitchen hack). Season with salt and pepper.

Serve up: Arrange the sugar snap peas, broccolini, radish and salad leaves on a large serving platter. Scatter over the almonds and crumble over the feta. Drizzle with the dressing and top with the remaining mint. Enjoy! Serves 3-4.

Kitchen hack: The dressing is blended to create a smooth and creamy consistency. If you don't have a stick blender or food processor, finely chop the mint and then whisk with the remaining ingredients. The dressing won't be as creamy, but it will be just as delicious!
